question_text: Which facts determine whether a vehicular crossing obstructs an accessible parking route?
choices: Accept a route because it connects two points on the drawing without checking field conditions.
Evaluate the route continuity and crossing conditions under the governing route provisions rather than deciding from the word obstruction alone.

Apply ramp dimensions before confirming which route the project must provide.
